name: react-monorepo
title: React monorepo (Turborepo)
description: Yarn workspaces + Turborepo: one or more Vite/React 19 apps over shared packages — an RTK Query data layer with a single baseApi, better-auth session handling, a shadcn-style UI kit with light/dark theming, layouts and state screens, and generated OpenAPI types.

ui.title: UI kit (@scope/ui)
ui.description: shadcn-style Radix components, a Formik+Zod form helper, light/dark theming with a no-flash init script, and page-meta helpers.

api.title: Data layer (@scope/api)
api.description: One shared RTK Query baseApi that every feature extends via injectEndpoints, a configured store, and an upload-aware base query. Endpoint names and tagTypes live in one global namespace — collisions are silent, so keep them unique.

auth.title: Auth client (@scope/auth)
auth.description: better-auth browser client, session slice, route guards and login redirects, shared across every app via a cross-subdomain cookie.

layouts.title: Layouts (@scope/layouts)
layouts.description: App shell, auth layout, marketing layout, error boundary and the loading/empty/forbidden/not-found state screens.

config.title: Shared config (@scope/config)
config.description: Base tsconfigs, the shared Vite config factory, the ESLint base and the Tailwind theme.

types.title: Generated API types (@scope/types)
types.description: OpenAPI-generated request/response types and Zod schemas, regenerated from the backend's /openapi-json.

telemetry.title: Browser monitoring → OpenObserve
telemetry.description: The @acme/telemetry package: OpenObserve RUM and logs in every app — page views, errors (including the error boundary's), slow resources, user actions, the signed-in user id, and traceparent headers on API calls so frontend and backend traces link up. Session replay is off unless a project turns it on. Off at runtime until VITE_OPENOBSERVE_* are set.

app-auth.title: Auth app
app-auth.description: Login, signup, forgot/reset password, email verification. The one app that owns the session; the others redirect here.

app-client.title: Client app
app-client.description: The authenticated product surface — app shell, protected routing, feature directories.

app-admin.title: Admin console
app-admin.description: Internal console over the same data layer, gated to the admin and superuser roles in the UI. The API must enforce the role on every endpoint it calls.

app-landing.title: Marketing site
app-landing.description: Public marketing site: a home page, an SEO route table, and build-time robots.txt, sitemap.xml and security.txt.

realtime.title: Socket.IO client
realtime.description: socket.io-client wired to the backend's /realtime path, with room helpers and shared event-name constants. Pairs with the nest-api realtime feature.

pwa.title: Installable PWA (client app)
pwa.description: vite-plugin-pwa configured for the client app: app-shell offline caching, and registerType 'prompt' so a new build waits for the user instead of swapping assets under a running app. The update prompt and install button are yours to build with the plugin's useRegisterSW.

charts.title: Charts (client app)
charts.description: ApexCharts and react-apexcharts in the client app, with a theme-aware chart palette (the --chart-* tokens in the UI kit). No chart components ship.

docker.title: Docker image
docker.description: Multi-stage build producing a static bundle per app, served by the nginx config in docker/ (cache rules, SPA fallback, security headers).

hooks.title: seed each app's .env from .env.example
hooks.run: for d in apps/*/; do [ -f "$d.env.example" ] && cp -n "$d.env.example" "$d.env"; done; true

hooks.title: format (the feature strip leaves valid but unformatted code)
git init
hooks.run: git init -q && git add -A && git commit -qm 'chore: scaffold {{name}} from the react-monorepo template'

nextSteps: Edit apps/*/.env — each app needs VITE_APP_API_URL and the sibling app origins.
yarn dev            # turbo runs every app's Vite server
yarn typecheck      # turbo, across apps and packages
